Physical Description: Sliverphish are small gremlin-like elemental creatures from the plane of earth, holding an assortment of light sensitive minerals all over their body. These creatures have pallid gray skin with flecks of minerals all over their bodies, large expressive eyes which lack pupils or iris, wide mouths filled with an assortment of crooked and jagged teeth along with slits for their nostrils and ears. They tend to crawl across the ground on all fours, making them appear smaller than their already diminutive statures.

Society: These creatures have zero value for life, especially those of other sliverphish and will gladly throw others in the way of them if it means garnering safety and better opportunities. Their societies are loosely held together through fear and intimidation, with a single strong sliverphish ruling with a shaky iron fist…usually being overtaken by some foreign race. Sliverphish breed in massive quantities, their numbers constantly fluctuating as a massive amount are bred, then a massive amount are killed not long after.

Relations: Sliverphish do not get along with other races but this matters very little when most races are easily able to force sliverphish to do what they want.

Alignment and Religion: Sliverphish are most commonly chaotic neutral however they can display a wider variety of alignments, especially if they are forced into one moral direction by another.

Adventurers: A willing adventurer is a rarity among sliverphish, often they are instead forced into it by some third party – this leads to many of them being ‘indentured servants’ of other underground races like dwarves or gnomes. More rarely above ground races will take sliverphish members under their wing, usually as a means of acquiring cheap and expendable labor.

Standard Racial Traits (-1 RP)
Ability Score Modifiers: Sliverphish gain a +2 bonus to constitution and a –2 penalty to wisdom. They also gain a +2 bonus to charisma and a –4 penalty to strength.
Size: Sliverphish are Small creatures and gain a +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls , a –1 penalty to their CMB and CMD , and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.
Type: Sliverphish are outsiders with the native and earth subtypes.
Base Speed: Sliverphish have a base speed of 20 feet.
Languages: Sliverphish begin play speaking Common and Terran. Sliverphish with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Aquan, Ignan, Dwarven, Gnome, Auran, and Draconic. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

Defense Racial Traits

Unnatural: Sliverphish unnerve normal animals, and train to defend themselves against the inevitable attacks from such creatures. Sliverphish take a –4 penalty on all Charisma-based skill checks to affect creatures of the animal type, and receive a +4 dodge bonus to AC against animals. Animals’ starting attitude toward members of this race is one step worse than normal.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

Bonus Feat (Ally Shield): All sliverphish gain ally shield as a bonus feat at 1st level.

Movement Racial Traits

Climb: Sliverphish have a climb speed of 20 feet, and gain the +8 racial bonus on Climb checks that a climb speed normally grants.

Senses Racial Traits

Darkvision: Sliverphish can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

Weakness Racial Traits

Light Blindness: Abrupt exposure to bright light blinds sliverphish for 1 round; on subsequent rounds, they are dazzled as long as they remain in the affected area.
Vulnerable to Sunlight: Sliverphish take 1 point of Constitution damage after every hour they are exposed to sunlight.
Elemental Vulnerability (Fire): Sliverphish have vulnerability to fire.
